model.selection: One larger English model fixed before all searches; no target-specific tuning or neural training

scope: All candidates are conditional on English bijective monoalphabetic substitution. Forward replay checks consistency, not a historical decipherment. Nulls are two exploratory shuffles, not a significance test.

exploratory_null_comparison.limitation: Two shuffles and unequal numbers of target/null restarts do not yield a p-value or a correctness probability
